labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Second try shows no_wrap column squashing other columns; first try wrap is documented behaviour.

items.body:
Thanks for the detailed report. Two parts to it:

- In the first try, `overflow` only takes effect when wrapping is off. Without `no_wrap=True` the cell wraps, which is documented behaviour; see [the table docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) for `no_wrap`.
- In the second try, the last column ellipsizes as expected, but the other columns shrink to almost nothing. That looks like a separate width-allocation bug in `no_wrap` columns, possibly the same as #2890. The maintainer will review.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
